asset.title: Page@2e413e4be4f436ecabeaf76bbc41b736
asset.purpose: Live Playwright browser proof clip. Judge only visible product evidence: multi-client sync, advisory presence, no-clobber behavior, proposals, job/privacy/wall surfaces, and production honesty.

judge.summary: The video demonstrates a solid multi-agent workflow interacting with a financial spreadsheet, showing both public and private agent executions. However, it suffers from a long blank screen at the start that needs to be trimmed.

featureClarity.evidence: Shows collaborative spreadsheet editing and agent-driven cell updates clearly, though the initial blank screen delays the hook.

workflowCompleteness.evidence: Captures the full flow from entering the room, selecting the sheet, prompting the agent, and seeing the cell update.

visualDesign.evidence: Clean dark-mode interface with clear sidebars, though the density of text in the chat and trace log is high.

consistency.evidence: Aligns well with the product's core concept of combining spreadsheets, chat, and agent execution traces.

evidenceQuality.evidence: Authentic browser capture showing real-time UI updates, but marred by the initial loading delay.

legibility.evidence: Main spreadsheet cells and chat messages are readable, but the bottom trace log text is quite small.

professionalRelevance.evidence: Highly relevant to financial analysts and diligence teams looking to automate spreadsheet workflows.

productionHonesty.evidence: Shows actual agent execution latency and step-by-step trace logs honestly.

observedEvidence: Multi-client sync and agent execution on a spreadsheet
Public and private agent chat channels
Real-time cell updates driven by agent prompts

defects.observed: There is a prolonged blank white screen for the first 8 seconds of the video.
defects.fix: Trim the first 8 seconds of the video so it starts directly on the landing page or room entry.

judge.suggestedReadmeCaption: Watch NodeAgent automatically update specific cells in a shared Q3 variance spreadsheet based on natural language instructions in both public and private channels.
